person.name: Jeremy McKeehen
person.headline: From code to plastic.
person.summary: Technical founder and product engineer. Co-founder of MetaTravelers — built the digital launch system, the Legendari physical line, and the AI-first operating layer behind a two-person company.

projects.name: Genesis Launch System
projects.summary: Smart contract, generative 3D pipeline, rendering, metadata, and delivery for the MetaTravelers digital launch.

projects.name: Legendari Production & Fulfillment
projects.summary: Physical Legendari action figure line: design partners, manufacturing, crowdfunding, and international fulfillment.
projects.outcome: 673 Kickstarter backers and over 10k units shipped internationally across 22 countries.

projects.name: Baton
projects.summary: Ranking engine for human attention in multi-agent systems.
projects.outcome: Open source (MIT). Runs in daily production coordinating agent workflows behind MetaTravelers.

projects.name: Company Second Brain
projects.summary: Agent-side operating layer for reports, support replies, and content drafts with human approval.
projects.outcome: Every report, support reply, and content draft starts agent-side; humans approve, not assemble.

projects.name: Commerce System
projects.summary: Shopify storefront supporting international collector commerce.
projects.outcome: Storefront supporting international collector commerce across 22 countries.

experience.summary: Built the digital launch system, pivoted to physical collectibles, and rebuilt operations AI-first for a two-person company.
highlights: Built the launch system across smart contract work, a generative 3D asset pipeline, automated rendering, metadata, and delivery. The result sold out in 15 minutes.
Shipped Legendari physical figures with design partners, factory QC, crowdfunding, and fulfillment across 22 countries.
Rebuilt the company AI-first: agent orchestration, second brain, and human-reviewed workflows.

experience.summary: Full-stack engineering on private equity / fund accounting platforms after starting in application support.
highlights: Built Cucumber UI testing coverage estimated to save ~800 manual QA hours per cycle.
Worked across C#/.NET, TypeScript/JavaScript, Knockout, Python, MongoDB, and SQL.

availability.seeking: Looking for founder-mode product engineering: AI-first product teams, commerce platforms, and zero-to-one environments where ownership beats job descriptions.
